title: Fully AI Generated Game: King & Witch
author: TawusGame

replies.author: TawusGame
replies.body: Making games is very easy now. I uploaded my old GDD document, and it understood and created a large part of the game. Then I refined it by giving small prompts to fix and improve things.

replies.author: TawusGame
replies.body: This was my first attempt using AI. I’ll be releasing two more games soon. The indie and casual game sectors are officially over.

replies.author: TawusGame
replies.body: I know it's not very good. I used the GDD from one of the first games I made with Unity. I should mention that it was more of an experiment.

comments.author: DayCompetitive1106
comments.body: 5 word long prompt and 30 second of generating response? gtfo with such crap

replies.author: TawusGame
replies.body: Actually, the flowchart, Gantt chart, and level design sections make up a total of 13 pages. I submitted one of my old projects just for testing purposes.

replies.author: TawusGame
replies.body: When I made this game with Unity at the time, it took me two weeks. It was one of my first projects. Thinking about it now, making games feels much easier.
